# Docs Agent Endpoints (llms.txt) — Mental Model

Three Astro endpoints serve plain markdown for agents, all driven by ONE source-of-truth glob in [_llm-sources.ts](apps/docs/src/pages/_llm-sources.ts) (`docSources` = `../content/docs/grid/**/*.{md,mdx}`, `demoSources`, `demoAppSources`, plus `keyToSlug`/`sectionOf`/`hasDoc`/`resolveDemo`/`SECTION_ORDER`/`CORE_ORDER`/`compareSlugsInSection`/`apiAreaOf`/`API_AREA_ORDER`). Transform logic in [_llm-markdown.ts](apps/docs/src/pages/_llm-markdown.ts) (`mdxToAgentMarkdown`, `extractFrontmatter`, `resolveAudienceRegions`, `filterFrameworkTabs`, `selectAgentSourcePaths`).

| Endpoint                                       | Content                                                                              | Size       |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| `[...slug].md.ts`                              | per-page `.md` companion for every docs page (637: 58 prose + 579 TypeDoc API)       | —          |
| `llms.txt.ts`                                  | curated PROSE link INDEX + preamble + task→page routing table; API is a POINTER only | ~18 kB     |
| `llms-api.txt.ts`                              | exhaustive TypeDoc symbol index (592) grouped by `## area` (`buildApiIndex(origin)`) | ~55 kB     |
| `llms-full.txt.ts`                             | header + `## Contents` map + full PROSE corpus inlined, then a LINKED API index      | ~780 kB    |
| `llms-full-{react,vue,angular,vanilla}.txt.ts` | thin wrappers calling `buildFull(origin, framework)`                                 | 405–500 kB |

- The per-framework variants stay under the ~500 kB single-fetch ceiling of `fetch_webpage`-class tools; the cross-framework `llms-full.txt` exceeds it BY DESIGN — point single-stack tools at the scoped variant.

## framework scoping (Jun 2026)

- Two-part trim in `buildFull(origin, framework)`: (1) `isForeignFrameworkPage(slug, framework)` (slug-prefix match on `grid/{angular,react,vue}/`) drops whole foreign adapter trees incl. their `/api/` pages; (2) `frameworkFilter` → `filterFrameworkTabs(body, framework)` keeps only the matching `<TabItem>` in framework tab groups.
- A group counts as "framework" iff it has a React/Vue/Angular label (npm/CDN/bundler tabs survive). `vanilla` keeps TypeScript/JavaScript/HTML labels. FALLBACK: a group with no tab for the target falls back to the vanilla/TS tab, else keeps ALL (never empties a group).
- INVARIANT: `filterFrameworkTabs` MUST run BEFORE the step-2b tab flatten, while `<Tabs>/<TabItem>` structure is intact (it operates on the whole body before the fenced split, like `resolveAudienceRegions`).
- Bare `llms-full.txt` = `framework: null` = everything.
- DECIDED: `<AgentSource paths="…" />` (inlines repo-root `demos/` source) gains optional `react`/`vue`/`angular` attrs — comma-separated framework-native path lists that REPLACE `paths` for that scoped corpus. `selectAgentSourcePaths(tag, framework)` returns `attr(framework) ?? attr('paths')`; `vanilla`, cross-framework, and per-page `.md` keep `paths`. `langOfPath(p)` infers the fence lang (`.vue`→`vue`, `.tsx`→`tsx`). Step-3b regex is `/<AgentSource\b[^>]*\/?>/g` (multi-line tags; attr values contain no `>`/quotes).
- DECIDED: react/vue/angular variants (NOT vanilla, NOT cross-framework) OMIT inline demos — bare `<DemoName />` and `<ShowSource file>` become a one-line `.md` pointer (`demoPointer()`), gated by `AgentMarkdownOptions.omitDemoComponents` + `demoPageUrl`. WHY: demo `.astro` sources are vanilla-only (`queryGrid` + `HTMLElement` renderers), directly contradicting each adapter's "use components, never return HTMLElement" rule. Saves ~58 kB per variant. `buildHeader` has 3 branches: null (cross), vanilla (emphasize `gridConfig.features` over light DOM, demos inlined), adapter frameworks (components not HTMLElement, demos linked). The per-page `.md` endpoint does NOT pass the flag.
- RULE: framework-blind pollution must be fixed in the MDX `<Tabs>`, NOT the generator (the generator only filters what is already tabbed). Fixed at source: api-reference "Header & Toolbar Content" and core.mdx "Light DOM renderers" were converted to `<Tabs>`; plugin `## Installation` (a bare side-effect-import fence) is DROPPED in adapter variants via `PLUGIN_KEEP_SECTIONS_ADAPTER` (= `PLUGIN_KEEP_SECTIONS` minus `Installation`) since the `Basic Usage` tab shows the framework-native import.

## content policy

- DECIDED: `llms-full.txt` inlines PROSE only; per-symbol TypeDoc API is LINKED. WHY: inlining all 579 API `.md` (~1 MB) doubled the file to 2.2 MB and buried the conceptual docs. `sectionOf(slug) === 'API'` partitions the two.
- DECIDED: a page opts OUT of the corpus via frontmatter `llmsFull: false` (parsed in `splitFrontmatter`, surfaced by `extractFrontmatter`); it STAYS linked in `llms.txt`. Flagged (9): `grid/ai.mdx` (meta) + all 4 changelogs + the 4 third-party `grid/recipes/` pages. Deliberately NOT flagged: `grid/comparison.mdx`, `grid/demos.mdx`, `grid/recipes/index.mdx` and the 3 first-party recipes (all carry teaching value). Guides all kept; API pages unaffected.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, #452): all task-oriented how-tos live in one `grid/recipes/` section (`sectionOf` → `'Recipes'`, after `Plugins` in `SECTION_ORDER`), regardless of whether they use third-party libs. WHY: readers navigate by "how do I build X", not by dependency provenance — the old `guides/common-patterns.mdx` was already described as "recipes" by 11 of its 13 inbound links. Diátaxis: both are how-to guides. RULED OUT: splitting the section by first-party/third-party — that's a maintainer taxonomy leaking into reader IA. The distinction survives only as per-page `llmsFull: false` so agents don't suggest `pdfmake` unprompted. INVARIANT: every recipe page uses exactly these h2s in this order — `## What you need`, `## Code`, `## Caveats`, `## See also` — preceded by a bold `**Problem:**` lead paragraph (no `## Problem` heading). Sub-tasks are h3 under `## Code`. Enforced across all 7 pages; `recipes/index.mdx` documents the shape. Each recipe leaves a one-line `:::tip` signpost on the point-of-need page.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, #452): `guides/common-patterns.mdx` DELETED (1233 lines, 25% of the guides section). WHY: seven of its sections wrapped 4-framework `<Tabs>` around a byte-identical `gridConfig` — the page's own notes said the config never varies, so the tabs cost 4x bytes for zero information. Feature-combination sections (data browsing, grouping, master-detail, export-selected, high-volume) were derivable from the feature pages. Salvaged: `RowTransaction` shape/ordering/sync-vs-async → `core.mdx#row-transactions` (reference); framework event-binding tabs + camelCase-vs-kebab-case rule → `api-reference.mdx#listening-to-events` (reference); editable-grid-with-undo, real-time-streaming, scroll-and-render → `grid/recipes/` (how-to). 13 inbound links repointed.
- DECIDED: page ORDER is generic → specific (earlier content anchors the model). Two tiers: `SECTION_ORDER` (Core Documentation → Guides → Plugins → Plugin Development → Framework Adapters → Angular/React/Vue → API), then `compareSlugsInSection(section, a, b)` — Core follows the curated `CORE_ORDER` arc (introduction → getting-started → core → demos → architecture → api-reference → errors → comparison → changelog), every other section alphabetical. SHARED by `llms.txt.ts` + `llms-full.txt.ts` so index and corpus never disagree. Pages absent from `CORE_ORDER` sort alphabetically after the listed ones.
- DECIDED: the agent-steering preamble is a hand-authored constant in `_llm-agent-preamble.ts` (NOT a docs page) — `AGENT_PREAMBLE_FULL` after the header in `llms-full.txt`, `AGENT_PREAMBLE_SHORT` after the intro in `llms.txt`. It carries imperative codegen guardrails (RULE 0 = prefer one `gridConfig`; height-required; editing is opt-in; side-effect imports; plugin order/compat; `cell-activate` not `cell-click`; don't add SelectionPlugin for a clickable row; `await grid.ready()`). This framing is agent-ONLY so it has no home in `content/docs/`; the factual gotchas DO live in human docs. RULED OUT: an `ai-guide.mdx` page (would read bizarrely to humans or duplicate content). This is the ONE exception to "everything derives from `docSources`" — keep both variants in sync with the human docs they summarise.
- DECIDED: the `ai.mdx` size table is rendered by `LlmFileSizes.astro`, computed at BUILD TIME by calling the real generators (`buildIndex` from `llms.txt.ts`, `buildApiIndex` from `llms-api.txt.ts`, `buildFull` from `_llm-full-builder.ts`) over `Astro.site.origin` — never hardcoded. DOWNLOAD SIZE ONLY. RULED OUT: an "approx. tokens" column (chars÷4) — it overstates cost because the common pattern is query-based retrieval, and it scared users off a workflow that handles these files fine.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): the exhaustive TypeDoc list moved OUT of `llms.txt` into `llms-api.txt` (`buildApiIndex`). WHY: 592 symbol links were ~75% of `llms.txt`'s bytes (70 kB → 18 kB after the split), turning the cheap orientation read into one of the most expensive fetches. `llms.txt` keeps a per-area SYMBOL COUNT list + a link to `llms-api.txt`. Both render from the same `docSources` glob, so they cannot drift.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): `buildFull` emits a `## Contents` map between the header and the first page (`renderContents(origin, prosePages)`) — `- **<H1 title>** — <frontmatter description> (<origin>/<slug>.md)`, grouped by `SECTION_ORDER`. WHY: the preamble tells agents to download and grep a ~19k-line file; without a map a grep hit is unlocatable and the corpus's coverage is invisible. The listed title is the EXACT `# <title>` heading further down, so "grep the map, jump to the heading" works. Costs ~20 kB (+2.7%).
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): `content/docs/grid/introduction.mdx` `<Audience only="agent">` carries a `_## WHERE TO LOOK — task → page` table; `AGENT_PREAMBLE_SHORT` carries a condensed copy for `llms.txt`. Keep the two in sync. Paths in both are stated as relative to `https://toolboxjs.com` because they are code spans, not links, so `rewriteDocLink` never touches them.
- DECIDED (#450): guides are ONE TOPIC PER PAGE — `platform.mdx` = environments + support commitments, `accessibility.mdx` = a11y mechanics, `i18n.mdx` = all translation surfaces (`a11y.messages`, `locale`, `Intl` formatting, RTL). WHY: i18n is a cross-cutting ~150-line topic that reads as filler on both other pages; a config key is documented once, on the page that owns its topic, with a `<LinkCard>` from the others. `support-policy.mdx` was merged INTO `platform.mdx` (its `#browser-support`/`#security`/`#server-side-rendering` anchors are already redirect + inbound-link targets). Guides auto-register via `autogenerate: { directory: 'grid/guides' }` — no sidebar edit needed; DO delete any `redirects` entry whose key now matches a real page slug.

## transform invariants (`mdxToAgentMarkdown`)

- Runs on PROSE segments only — fenced code is split out via `/(```[\s\S]*?```)/g` and preserved verbatim (example `import`s inside fences are real guidance).
- Flattens Starlight components so no raw JSX leaks: `<Tabs>/<TabItem label>` → `#### label`; `<LinkCard title description href />` → `- [title](href): description`; `<Card title>` → `### title`; `<Aside type[ title]>` → `:::type[title]` … `:::`; `<Badge text>` → `(text)`; `<CardGrid>/<Steps>/<FileTree>/<Icon>` stripped. `:::` directives are otherwise left in place.
- INVARIANT: ALL component replacements operate on OPEN and CLOSE tags INDEPENDENTLY (never `<X>…</X>` pairs) so they survive the code-fence segment split — a component whose children contain a code block has its open/close tags in different segments.
- INVARIANT (demo inlining): only imported `.astro` components whose path matches `/(^|\/)demos\//` are inlined as `ts` (via `resolveDemo`). Other imported `.astro` components are interactive WIDGETS with no inlineable source (`<ThemeBuilder/>`, `<ShowSource/>`) — their leftover tags are STRIPPED (step 4b), not inlined. Before this split, `<CSSVariableReference/>` emitted a bogus `<!-- demo source not found: … -->`.
- DECIDED (May 2026): `<CSSVariableReference/>` is the ONE non-demo widget NOT stripped — step 4b replaces it with `AgentMarkdownOptions.cssVarReference`, an injected markdown table built once from `CSS_VARIABLES` (`apps/docs/src/data/css-variable-registry.ts`) as `cssVariableReferenceMarkdown` in `_llm-sources.ts` and passed in by BOTH endpoints. Columns: variable name + description only (the widget's runtime "current value" column is meaningless in static markdown). Grouped by `### {category}`. `<ThemeBuilder/>` stays stripped. INVARIANT preserved: the transform imports NO doc data — the registry import lives in `_llm-sources`, not `_llm-markdown`.
- INVARIANT: `sectionOf` classifies `'API'` two ways — `/(^|\/)api\//` OR a reflection-kind dir (`/(classes|interfaces|functions|types|variables|enumerations)\//`). The second catches per-plugin TypeDoc pages (`grid/plugins/clipboard/classes/...`) that have no `/api/` segment.
- INVARIANT (`{GRID_STATS.*}`): step 2a is the ONLY MDX expression the transform resolves — `AgentMarkdownOptions.gridStats` is `Record<string, string | number>`, keys mirror `apps/docs/src/data/grid-stats.ts` (plugin count, core gzip kB, core dep count, package versions, adapter peer ranges). Unknown keys collapse to `''`. WHY it matters when authoring: any OTHER `{…}` expression is stripped, and inline code spans are NOT evaluated by MDX — so a build-time value must be written as bare `{GRID_STATS.x}` in prose, never inside backticks and never as `<code>{…}</code>` (a non-imported JSX tag survives into the corpus verbatim). Brace shorthand like `grid-{angular,react,vue}` is an MDX parse ERROR — spell the three names out.
- INVARIANT: `keyToSlug` lowercases — Starlight serves TypeDoc routes lowercased (`Classes/DataGridElement.mdx` → `/classes/datagridelement/`).
- INVARIANT: internal doc links are rewritten to ABSOLUTE `.md` URLs. `rewriteDocLink(url, hasDoc, origin)` returns `${origin}/${slug}.md${suffix}`; BOTH endpoints (`_llm-full-builder.ts`, `[...slug].md.ts`) MUST pass `origin`. WHY: the preamble instructs agents to download a corpus and grep it locally, at which point a root-relative `/grid/core.md` has no base to resolve against. Omitting `origin` silently degrades to the old root-relative form — covered by `_llm-markdown.spec.ts` → "internal link rewriting".
- INVARIANT: a code fence in authored MDX must never swallow a heading or `:::` directive. `_docs-fences.spec.ts` walks every page under `content/docs` (skipping generated TypeDoc dirs) and fails the build if a block is unclosed or contains a heading / nested info-string fence. WHY: `architecture.mdx` shipped a ```css block with no closer; MDX rendered it silently while the whole `## DOM Structure` section vanished from every corpus. A parity/even-count check does NOT catch this — the swallowed block supplies its own closer. Shell dialects are exempt (`# comment` is legal there).
- INVARIANT: head `rel="alternate"` links in `astro.config.mjs` point at SAME-ORIGIN `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` (not raw.githubusercontent.com). `public/robots.txt` advertises both alongside the `Sitemap:` line.
- VALIDATE transform changes with `bun nx test docs` — `apps/docs/src/pages/_llm-markdown.spec.ts` unit-tests `mdxToAgentMarkdown`/`resolveAudienceRegions`/`filterFrameworkTabs`. Spot-check `dist/docs/llms-full.txt` for residual raw JSX.

## docs build output

- DECIDED (Jun 2026): docs build to workspace-root `dist/docs` (was `apps/docs/dist`). SET IN: `apps/docs/astro.config.mjs` `outDir: '../../dist/docs'` + `pagefindDir: resolve(rootDir,'dist/docs/pagefind')`; `apps/docs/project.json` `outputs: ["{workspaceRoot}/dist/docs"]`; `ci.yml` `upload-pages-artifact path: dist/docs`.
- INVARIANT: the `build` target MUST run with `process.cwd()` = workspace root, NOT `apps/docs` — `project.json` build has NO `cwd` and the command is `astro build --root apps/docs`. WHY: Astro's `getOutDirWithinCwd` only uses `outDir` as the image-staging `serverRoot` when `outDir` starts with `process.cwd()`; otherwise it silently falls back to `<cwd>/.astro/` → the image optimizer reads from `apps/docs/.astro/_astro/…` (never staged) → `ENOENT … logo.<hash>.svg`. RULED OUT: keeping `cwd: apps/docs` with a root-level `outDir`. `serve`/`preview` keep `cwd: apps/docs` (dev image handling is on-demand via Vite).
- INVARIANT: the sitemap is auto-enabled by Starlight's bundled `@astrojs/sitemap` because `site: 'https://toolboxjs.com'` is set (no literal `sitemap` in config). Emits `sitemap-index.xml` + `sitemap-0.xml`; `robots.txt` references `sitemap-index.xml`.

## generated API docs (typedoc)

- INVARIANT: EVERY generated API dir is gitignored (`.gitignore` ~L68-78: `**/api-generated/`, `**/api/`, `**/Classes/`, `**/Interfaces/`, `**/Functions/`, `**/Types/`, `**/Enums/`, `**/RFC/*`). Hand-edits to `apps/docs/src/content/docs/grid/**/{api,Classes,Interfaces,Types,Variables}/**` are THROWAWAY — fix `libs/grid/scripts/typedoc-to-mdx.ts` (or the source JSDoc) instead. Regenerate: `bun nx typedoc grid` / `bun nx typedoc grid-angular`.
- INVARIANT: Astro LOWERCASES slugs. Relative links written as `](./Interfaces/Foo/)` 404 on case-sensitive hosting; the generator must emit lowercase (`/grid/api/plugin-development/classes/basegridplugin/`). Audit with `grep -rn "](\./\(Interfaces\|Classes\|Types\|Functions\|Variables\|Enumerations\)/" apps/docs/src/content/docs --include=*.mdx` — must be 0.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `typedoc-to-mdx.ts` emits `kind:32` Variables via `genVariable` (`## Members` table from `type.declaration.children`) and a per-section `index.mdx` via `writeSectionIndex` (core / plugin-development / framework-adapters). Variables that merge into a companion type alias (`GridClasses`→`GridClassName`, `GridCSSVars`, `GridDataAttrs`, `RenderPhase`) return `''` — `buildVariableMergeMap(json)` MUST run BEFORE `buildTypeRegistry(json)` in `main()`.
- GOTCHA: TypeDoc's `@category`/module assignment — not the source file — decides the output section. `GridSelectors` is declared in `core/constants.ts` but lands under `api/plugin-development/variables/gridselectors/`. Check the emitted path before writing a link.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `buildTypeRegistry` MUST skip `isNodeInternal(node)`. WHY: page emission already skips `@internal` nodes, so registering them made `{@link ColumnInternal}` emit a link to a page that is never written. Skipping degrades the link to a plain code span. `libs/grid/scripts/typedoc-to-mdx.ts`.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `genInterface` renders a `## Methods` section (`KIND.Method`, `!isNodeInternal`). WHY: it previously emitted properties only, so `PublicGrid` documented 0 of its ~30 methods. `libs/grid/scripts/typedoc-to-mdx.ts`.
- INVARIANT: every `## Properties` table row is prefixed with `propertyRowAnchor(p)` — a `<span id="<lowercased name>">` for properties that get no `#### <name>` detail section. WHY: `{@link Iface.prop}` always resolves to `#prop`; without the span those fragments 404. `tools/typedoc-mdx-shared.ts`.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `GENERATORS` in `tools/typedoc-mdx-shared.ts` includes `[KIND.Variable]: genVariable` so adapter `export const` values get pages. WHY: React `DataGrid`/`GridProvider`, Angular/Vue `GRID_ICONS`/`GRID_TYPE_DEFAULTS` are `forwardRef`/const declarations → TypeDoc `kind:32` → previously no page at all. Do NOT add `Variable` to `KIND_FOLDER_MAP` (that map is the cross-lib link fallback into grid-core paths, which have no `Variables/` area for adapters).
- INVARIANT: Vue SFCs (`.vue`) cannot be parsed by TypeDoc. `libs/grid-vue/src/typedoc-entry.ts` excludes them; the 9 `Tbw*` components are hand-documented in `apps/docs/src/content/docs/grid/vue/components.mdx` (registered in `astro.config.mjs`). A new Vue `.ts` export must be added to BOTH `index.ts` and `typedoc-entry.ts` or it silently has no docs.

## docs audit tooling

- `bun tools/docs-link-audit.ts` — internal-link/anchor gate over the content collection. Reports `missing-page`, `missing-anchor`, `uppercase-link`, `relative-from-non-index`, `via-redirect`. Must print `Total issues: 0`. Supersedes `.github/skills/docs-update/check-doc-links.mjs`.
- `bun tools/docs-api-coverage.ts` — public-API coverage gate. Must print `0 exports without a page or reference section`.
- INVARIANT: `slugify` in the link audit replaces **each** whitespace char with `-` (github-slugger semantics, NOT `\s+`). `"Local Sort & Filter Modes"` → `local-sort--filter-modes`.
- INVARIANT: relative links resolve from the page's **own URL** (`'/' + join(selfSlug, path)`), not `dirname(selfSlug)` — every page is served with a trailing slash, index or not.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026): `@internal` exports are **intentional exclusions**, not coverage gaps — the tag marks the plugin/framework-development surface. NEVER strip `@internal` to make the coverage report green. The tool lists them separately.
- Coverage counts a symbol as documented when it (a) has a generated page, (b) is a const merged into a companion type-alias page (detected via `^const <Name>` in the code fence), or (c) appears as a `## Symbol` heading or first table cell on a hand-written page.
